jobs.description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Native proficiency in

, you will be responsible for building and overseeing the quality governance framework for our Intellectual Property Operations (IPO) team. IP Monitoring:
Proactively monitor brand listings to detect and remove counterfeit products, ensuring a safe and consistent shopping experience for customers.

Vet seller distribution channels through pre- and post-gating reviews to ensure only authorized and compliant listings enter the marketplace.
Appeals & Escalation:
Conduct forensic reviews of seller appeals to verify the authenticity of supply chain documentation and accurately resolve suspected counterfeit disputes.

Rapidly process and investigate external reports of IP infringement to mitigate legal risks and maintain brand owner trust.

Quality Framework & Strategy:
Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive quality assurance framework for the IPO team. This includes defining clear quality standards, evaluation criteria, and performance metrics that align with business goals.
Process Auditing & Evaluation:

Lead, mentor, and coach a team of Quality Assurance Specialists. Provide regular feedback, conduct calibration sessions, and develop training programs to enhance their analytical skills and knowledge of quality standards.
Data-Driven Analysis:
Analyze quality metrics, including defect rates, resolution times
to identify trends, process bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.

Partner with the IP Operations Manager to provide insights that inform policy updates and process enhancements. Work with other cross-functional teams to share feedback and ensure a unified approach to quality.

Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
Certification in Quality Management (e.g., Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, CQE).
Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk) and customer engagement platforms (e.g., Genesys).
